source.title: Mid-Century Japanese Bird Art Print, Retro Blue Bird Poster, Minimalist Animal Illustration, Vintage Wall Decor, Modern Graphic Artwork

analysis.summary: Four stylized blue birds with bright red eyes huddle together in a graphic, color-blocked Japanese woodblock composition.
analysis.subject: A cluster of four stylized blue birds
analysis.setting: A minimalist, color-blocked background featuring rectangular planes of grey, yellow, and red.
analysis.action: The birds are standing close together, all facing right with wide, alert eyes.
analysis.style: Japanese woodblock print (Sosaku-hanga), featuring flat color planes, bold black outlines, visible wood grain texture, and slightly naive, modernist proportions.
analysis.composition: A tight, overlapping arrangement of subjects creating a rhythmic pattern. The birds occupy the central and lower two-thirds of the frame. The viewpoint is eye-level and flat.
analysis.typography: Vertical Japanese calligraphy in black ink on the left margin and top right corner, featuring stylized kanji characters.
analysis.mood: Serene yet alert, blending traditional craft with mid-century graphic modernism.
analysis.audience: Interior design enthusiasts looking for 'Japandi' or mid-century modern decor; bird watchers; collectors of vintage-style graphic art. Perfect for a minimalist living room or a study.
analysis.hook: The charm lies in the rhythmic repetition of the birds' rounded forms and the sharp, high-contrast pop of their red eyes against the cool teal feathers.

props: a stack of wooden bento boxes

outputs.title: Four Blue Songbirds
outputs.brief: Four teal birds with red eyes huddle together in a tight group, almost identical to the reference but with slightly more rounded head shapes. The birds occupy the center against horizontal blocks of muted green, mustard yellow, and brick red. Use the woodblock texture throughout, showing visible grain in the color planes. The calligraphy is placed in the top right and down the left side.

outputs.title: Trio of Alert Birds
outputs.brief: Three stylized teal birds with bright red eyes stand in a horizontal row, overlapping slightly. The middle bird is tucked just behind the outer two against a large cream top section and a split brick red and mustard bottom section. Tiny black woodblock-style leaf details are added near the birds' feet for extra detail. Calligraphy is reduced to a single vertical column on the far right margin.

outputs.title: Blue Bird Quadrant
outputs.brief: Four birds are arranged in a strict two-by-two grid, with each bird occupying its own distinct color block. The top-left bird is on a mustard background, top-right on green, bottom-left on red, and bottom-right on cream. Each bird faces towards the center of the poster, creating a symmetrical balance. The woodblock grain texture is heavily emphasized in the flat color areas, and calligraphy appears in small squares at the grid intersections.

outputs.title: Birds on a Winter Branch
outputs.brief: Several teal birds with red eyes are perched along a single horizontal black branch that spans the width of the frame. The background is divided into large vertical bands of mustard yellow and muted green to create a sense of height. Small cream-colored geometric circles representing snow are scattered across the top half of the composition. The birds are spaced further apart than in the reference, creating a rhythmic pattern across the horizontal plane.

outputs.title: Radial Bird Circle
outputs.brief: The birds are arranged in a playful circular formation with their tails pointing toward the center and their red eyes facing outward. This radial pattern creates a kaleidoscope effect using the teal, brick red, and mustard palette against a solid cream background. Geometric black lines connect the birds' feet in a central star-like shape. The entire piece maintains a heavy woodblock grain texture and flat, high-contrast lighting.

outputs.title: Huddled Teal Finches
outputs.brief: This is a fresh rendition of the four huddled birds, with minor adjustments to the beak angles and the thickness of the black outlines. The color blocking remains consistent, featuring teal bodies against a split mustard and red background. Woodblock grain is clearly visible in the muted green top section. Small Japanese characters are hand-painted in the margins using the same black ink style.

outputs.title: Five Birds Together
outputs.brief: This version adds a fifth bird to the cluster, creating a taller and denser arrangement of teal bodies. The birds are slightly smaller in scale to fit comfortably within the frame. The background blocks are shifted so the brick red section at the bottom is taller to accommodate the extra bird feet. The red eyes remain the highest point of contrast in the composition.

outputs.title: The Watchful Flight
outputs.brief: Four birds are arranged in a steep diagonal line from the bottom left corner to the top right corner. The bodies overlap significantly, showing the woodblock texture on their teal feathers and cream bellies. The background is divided diagonally, following the line of the birds with mustard yellow on top and muted green on the bottom. Calligraphy is placed in the open cream space in the top left corner.

outputs.title: Birds Among Bamboo Stalks
outputs.brief: The teal birds are framed between thick vertical stripes of muted green and mustard yellow, suggesting stylized bamboo stalks. The birds are positioned at different heights, peeking out from the 'stalks' with their bright red eyes aimed at the viewer. The brick red color is used as a narrow horizontal base strip along the bottom. The flat, graphic style maintains the visible wood grain texture of the original print.

outputs.title: Geometric Bird Totem
outputs.brief: The birds are stacked vertically in a central column, one on top of the other, facing in alternating directions. The background is split into three wide horizontal bands of cream, mustard, and green to anchor the stack. A thick brick red border surrounds the entire image for a bold, modern look. The red eyes are aligned in a vertical zigzag pattern, creating a striking graphic rhythm.

outputs.title: Four Teal Owls
outputs.brief: Four stylized teal owls with rounded bodies and high-contrast red eyes are huddled tightly together on a single moss green branch. The background is a minimalist color-block of ochre and cream. The composition maintains the rhythmic, overlapping pattern of the original birds, with visible wood grain texture throughout the teal feathers. Vertical black kanji lettering appears on the left margin.

outputs.title: Rainy Day Huddle
outputs.brief: The four original teal birds with red eyes are clustered together, but each holds a tiny, flat rust-red umbrella. The background consists of vertical bands of cream and moss green with abstract woodblock rain streaks. Their signature red eyes pop against the cool teal bodies in a tight, repetitive formation. Minimalist black calligraphy is placed in the top right corner.

outputs.title: Deep Sea School
outputs.brief: A rhythmic school of four teal fish with rounded, bulbous bodies and striking red eyes swim in a tight overlapping formation. The background features color-blocked horizontal bands of rust red and ochre representing stylized coral. The water is suggested by cream-colored negative space and heavy wood grain textures. Bold black outlines define the scales and fins.

outputs.title: Midnight Rooftop Prowl
outputs.brief: Four stylized teal cats with perfectly circular bodies and bright red eyes sit in a row on a rust-red roof ridge. Their silhouettes overlap rhythmically against a night sky made of a moss green block with a large ochre sun. Visible woodblock textures cover the flat color planes. The high-contrast red eyes are the sharp focal point against the teal fur. Stylized black lettering runs along the bottom edge.

outputs.title: Four Pond Frogs
outputs.brief: Four stylized, rounded teal frogs with large, high-contrast red eyes are stacked slightly on top of each other. They sit on a flat, color-blocked lily pad in moss green against a background of ochre and cream. The rhythmic repetition of their rounded heads mirrors the original bird composition. Heavy wood grain texture is visible in the teal skin areas, and black calligraphy sits on the left margin.

outputs.title: Teal Birds at the Diner
outputs.brief: The four teal birds with red eyes are perched along a rust-red counter ledge in a stylized minimalist diner. The background is a vertical split of ochre and cream, suggesting a wall and a window. A single small, round black coffee cup sits in front of the lead bird. The composition retains the tight, overlapping rhythmic pattern with flat planes of color and bold black outlines.

outputs.title: Winter Rabbit Huddle
outputs.brief: Four teal rabbits with rounded, hunched bodies and vibrant red eyes huddle together in a snowy field represented by a cream block. The sky above is a moss green rectangle with an ochre circle for a sun. Their long ears create a rhythmic, vertical pattern that echoes the original bird shapes. Woodblock texture creates a speckled effect throughout the print. Vertical black ink characters are on the right.

outputs.title: Modernist Robot Assembly
outputs.brief: Four teal, spherical robots with glowing red ocular lenses are grouped tightly on a rust-red assembly line. The background is a graphic grid of ochre and moss green panels. The forms are rounded and minimalist, maintaining the rhythmic overlapping aesthetic of the original Sosaku-hanga style. Heavy wood grain texture is applied to the metal surfaces, with black stylized kanji on the left side.

outputs.title: Four Watching Clouds
outputs.brief: Four rounded, stylized teal clouds with bright red eyes float in a tight cluster in a color-blocked sky of ochre and cream. The clouds have the same rhythmic, overlapping shapes as the original birds. The texture resembles coarse woodblock printing with visible fibers and grain. Bold black calligraphy is placed in the top right corner to balance the composition.

outputs.title: Teal Birds Joyride
outputs.brief: The four teal birds with red eyes are huddled in the back seat of a stylized, minimalist car interior. A block of rust red represents the upholstery, while the window shows a moss green and ochre landscape passing by. The composition focuses on the rhythmic repetition of their heads and red eyes peering over the window sill. Wood grain texture is prominent in the teal feathers, with black lettering in the margin.
